meta.title: A buyer who is not the owner cannot change ownership
gaps: act 1: POST /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/change_ownership is sent with no body — a request step carries the body the case writes (or a library/operation step has a working one)

The case's POST has no body, but request steps require a body; no operation or library case expresses change_ownership authorization for a non-owner buyer. Available ownership library cases test missing or invalid new owners and expect code
